# Catherine Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Personality

Catherine Andrews maintains an optimistic outlook on life. She prefers to focus on the positive, noting that such a mindset is necessary given her living situation with [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P21](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0021), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

## History

During the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village Improvement Society's fundraising campaign, Catherine Andrews made a secret contribution to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). This donation occurred shortly after [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md) had given the pair a grim refusal.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P36](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0036)_
